title: Floor1 concept-art coordinate grids
scope: 72 deterministic overlays across original and top-down concept sets; preserves clean inputs. Grids partition full native panel extent, including any source gutters; they do not establish canonical scale, equal world tile size or seamless geometry.

style.claim: Deterministic grid overlay only; no resampling, redraw, canonical scale or tile readiness claim.

sourceSets.projection: Mixed camera views: overhead room studies and frontal passages; orthogonal square architecture does not make these strict overhead gameplay maps.
Direct overhead room and passage compositions visually reviewed by coordinator; minor prop edging, shading and stylized readable prop details may remain. No mathematical camera verification.
